<thought>We identified the retrosynthetic step: the sulfonamide can be disconnected into the aromatic amine (the complex aryl with the N‑H) and phenyl‑sulfonyl chloride (the fluorophenyl sulfonyl chloride). The corresponding SMILES for these precursors are:
- Amine: Nc1cc(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1
- Sulfonyl chloride: ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(F)cc1

Thus the only valid precursor combination is the pair above.
